messages.subject: Project Onyx - completion bring-down (wrong Sarah?)
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Apologies - I think I had the wrong distribution list. This was meant for the Verdant Project Onyx financing team, not the litigation side. Please ignore. For the avoidance of doubt the bring-down disclosure for the Calderbrook subscription is with Denham Lewis and we're on track to sign Friday.

James

James Osei | Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
